header: DB-backed department resolution, built on `public.sail_department`. NAMING NOTE (28 Sep 2026): this table only actually holds DSP's own departments. SAIL is the parent body over 4 separate plants with only partly-overlapping structures, so the name is a known imprecision. I considered renaming the live table and deliberately deferred it (real, unverifiable blast radius: every Stage 8 migration script and any external tool that references `sail_department` by name would need to be found and updated in lockstep). So this module keeps the table's name rather than half-renaming just the code layer. Resolution is a live, normalized lookup against that table (300 rows) for anything typed in full or by its real code, plus a small, EXPLICIT alias table for short/cryptic forms a plain name match can't catch. I add alias entries only once confirmed directly (never guessed); see chat for how each one below was established.

symbols.name: formatDepartmentDisplay
symbols.sig: export function formatDepartmentDisplay(dept: string | null | undefined): string | null
doc: The department name as shown to people. Central Stores (CSD) is an administrative sub-department of Marketing, so I show it with that: "CENTRAL STORES DEPTT. (Marketing)"; a name that already ends in a bracket gets it inside the same bracket: "CENTRAL STORES (OFFICE, Marketing)" (never "(OFFICE) (Marketing)"). Null / blank gives null. This rule lives in this ONE place; every screen that shows a department name from the roster goes through it.

symbols.name: findSailDepartmentInText
symbols.sig: export async function findSailDepartmentInText( query: string,): Promise<{ group: DeptGroup; phrase: string } | null>
symbols.returns: Promise<{ group: DeptGroup; phrase: string } | null>
doc: Find a department mentioned ANYWHERE in free text (order-independent), matching a confirmed alias or a real stored name as a whole phrase. Longest match wins. NOTE: this is now ASYNC (DB-backed); the old departments.ts export was synchronous, so OmnibarModal.tsx's `findDepartmentInText(q)` call site (used to feed the "Intranet Sites" card) needs to become `await findSailDepartmentInText(q)` inside its existing async search handler. I flag this explicitly rather than leave it silently broken.
